title: project wireframes
overall_deck_description: Designed for digital product pitches and design reviews, this 25-slide deck adopts a crisp, modern tech aesthetic built around an off-white and cool-gray backdrop with high-contrast black typography. The color system uses dark slate for text, framed by light neutral backgrounds and a recurring signature two-tone horizontal accent bar (mint/teal paired with warm orange). Slide titles consistently feature an ultra-bold geometric sans-serif, while body and subtitle copy use a clean, legible regular sans-serif. The deck opens with a product-focused title slide showcasing device wireframe mockups, progresses through content using structured single- and two-column layouts, captions, and bold section-break slides to pace narrative phases, and closes with a reference and summary slide adhering to the same top-band framing.
